steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Sound in film is divided into diegetic, originating from within the film world, and non-diegetic, added for the audience from outside the narrative world. | Key Fact: Diegetic sound includes dialogue, ambient sound, on-screen music and sound effects that characters can theoretically hear. | Key Fact: Non-diegetic sound includes the musical score, voice-over narration and sound effects added for dramatic effect that characters cannot hear. | Key Fact: Sound can be further divided into on-screen and off-screen, with off-screen sound extending the diegetic world beyond the visible frame.
